name: Gadget purchase enquiry
description: Registers a gadget purchase enquiry and prepares WhatsApp.
steps: Confirm the original gold-and-black Santi Willz Services logo is visible without an RC line and only three service categories appear
Choose Buy a gadget and complete model, specifications and budget
Complete customer name, WhatsApp and location
Return to the website if a WhatsApp tab opens; verify Back is hidden after registration and Open WhatsApp remains available
expected: A unique SWS reference appears and WhatsApp opens with the order summary.

name: Automobile mobile enquiry
covers: mobile header original logo fully visible and proportional
steps: At mobile width, verify the full Santi Willz Services logo is visible, centered vertically, and not compressed or clipped by the WhatsApp link
Choose Source a vehicle and answer three questions
expected: A saved order reference is displayed and WhatsApp handoff is offered. The full original logo is legible without distortion or clipping in the mobile header.

name: Required answers guardrail
description: Blank answers cannot advance the wizard.
steps: Try Continue without choosing a request
Choose Installation then try Continue with blank answers
Complete Installation answers, go to contact details, enter ------- as the phone and attempt Continue
expected: Validation guidance appears and the wizard does not register an incomplete enquiry.

name: Technical repair guided enquiry
description: Technical repair path requests fault details and a valid contact number.
steps: Open Technical Support and choose Repair / troubleshooting
Enter valid contact information and register
expected: The order reference is displayed and the WhatsApp message includes the fault details.

name: Registration failure and retry
description: Failed registration keeps answers and allows retry without a false success.
steps: Start a Gadgets purchase enquiry and complete every field with test details
expected: A visible registration error appears, answers remain on the review screen, and the registration button is enabled for retry. No success reference or WhatsApp success claim is displayed.
